description: mod-invoice configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-invoice revision 15, image 6.1.3); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-invoice is a RAML Module Builder (Vert.x) module: it reads its database settings from DB_* variables, consumes and publishes data-import Kafka events, has no secret store, and takes its HTTP port from the http.port system property in JAVA_OPTIONS. Its Spring context also resolves the dotted mod.invoice.* and dataimport.* properties from the environment. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-invoice container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-invoice container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-invoice container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves about 390 MiB of the container for non-heap memory

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection, not a limit. Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-invoice is stateless apart from its data-import deduplication table in PostgreSQL; Kafka consumer groups spread data-import events across replicas. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-invoice endpoints. Use this only if different from default Kong configuration.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host (write instance)

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username, usually supplied from the secret store

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password, usually supplied from the secret store

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name; the module keeps its data-import deduplication table in a per-tenant schema there

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronously replicated read instance host; reads go to DB_HOST when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read instance; reads go to DB_HOST when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate(s) to validate the PostgreSQL server; when set, TLSv1.3 is required

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant per instance. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per instance shared by all tenants; when set, DB_MAXPOOLSIZE is ignored

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds after which a connection is closed (RMB default); 0 keeps idle connections open

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum connection lifetime in milliseconds (RMB default); 0 means unlimited

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a failed database connect; reconnecting is disabled when unset

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between reconnect attempts

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Query duration in milliseconds above which RMB logs EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host for the data-import event consumers and publisher

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor for Kafka topics created by this module. Value taken from bugfest; module default is 1

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Kafka producer max.request.size in bytes (module default)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Enables tenant collection topics ({ENV}.Default.{value}.{EVENT}); must be the same across all modules. Value taken from bugfest; per-tenant topics when unset

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment name used as the Kafka topic prefix; must match the other modules or data-import events are missed. Module default is folio

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Okapi URL set on data-import events this module publishes; module default is http://okapi:9130. Not set on bugfest

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: When false (Eureka), the event's token is not forwarded on data-import requests to other modules. Module default is true; bugfest sets false via -DSYSTEM_USER_ENABLED in JAVA_OPTS

EnvVars.name: dataimport.consumer.verticle.mandatory
EnvVars.description: Fails module start-up when the data-import Kafka consumers cannot be deployed. Value taken from bugfest; module default is false

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.kafka.DataImportConsumerVerticle.instancesNumber
EnvVars.description: Number of data-import consumer verticle instances (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.kafka.DataImportConsumer.loadLimit
EnvVars.description: Maximum in-flight data-import events per consumer before polling pauses (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.kafka.DataImportConsumerVerticle.maxDistributionNumber
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of data-import events processed concurrently by a verticle (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.kafka.CancelledJobConsumerVerticle.instancesNumber
EnvVars.description: Number of cancelled data-import job consumer verticle instances (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.kafka.CancelledJobExecutionConsumer.loadLimit
EnvVars.description: Maximum in-flight cancelled-job events per consumer before polling pauses (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.cache.cancelled.jobs.expiration.minutes
EnvVars.description: Retention in minutes of cancelled data-import job IDs in the local cache (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.profile-snapshot-cache.expiration.time.seconds
EnvVars.description: Expiration in seconds of cached data-import job profile snapshots (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.cache.settings-entries.expiration-time.seconds
EnvVars.description: Expiration in seconds of cached settings entries (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.cache.settings-entries.bypass-cache
EnvVars.description: Bypasses the settings cache and reads settings on every request (module default false)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.exchange-rate.expiration.time.seconds
EnvVars.description: Expiration in seconds of cached currency exchange rates (module default)

EnvVars.name: mod.invoice.restclient.pool.size
EnvVars.description: HTTP client connection pool size for calls to other modules; a built-in default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the module process. -Dhttp.port=8082 moves RMB off its default port 8081, which the Eureka sidecar uses; it must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL. Heap sizing comes from the java block.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: External Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties (log4j2-json.properties is also bundled)

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier. Must match the module's ENV

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-invoice container is reachable from its sidecar; the port must match -Dhttp.port

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-invoice module deployed alongside this sidecar
